articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: Tesla's Biggest Robotics Advantage Isn't AI, RoboStrategy CEO Says
articles.description: When investors think about Tesla Inc‘s (NASDAQ:TSLA) humanoid robotics ambitions, the conversation usually begins with artificial intelligence. Andrew Kang, CEO of RoboStrategy, Inc. (NASDAQ:BOT), argues they’re looking in the wrong place. Tesla’s greatest long-term advantage is something far less glamorous, he says. “It is their manufacturing competency and resources,” Kang told Benzinga in an email. articles.headline: Somnia Lab Trains Intimacy Robots with Human Motion-Capture
articles.description: Somnia Lab, a Shenzhen-based robotics company, uses motion-capture suits on humans to teach their upcoming intimacy robot 165 distinct poses for lifelike movements, warmth, touch response, and memory of interactions. The video, shared by the company and news outlet RT, shows the process and has drawn views along with jokes, surprise, and thoughts on loneliness and relationships. Independent reports confirm the method trains the robot's 24 degrees of freedom for smooth, natural transitions, with deliveries planned for late 2027.
